name: Champion's Feast

start.dialog: Sumo HUNGRY! Need training food! Special upland truffles - ten of them! Grow near the cliff roots! Find for me? I give you... SUMO WISDOM! And maybe cookie!
start.objective: Collect 10 upland truffles from cliff root areas

progress.dialog: Still hungry! Need MORE truffles! Big ones! Juicy ones!

complete.dialog: SO MANY TRUFFLES! Sumo HAPPY! You strong! You wise! Take this - Sumo Belt! Make you PUSH like SUMO! Very powerful! Very stylish!

party_comments.kade: That's... a lot of food for one person.
party_comments.twist: He's like a big cuddly mountain!
party_comments.grit: Sumo training requires serious calories. Respect.

hidden_outcome: If you bring 20 truffles, Sumo Red declares you his 'apprentice' and teaches the 'Earth Shaker' body slam technique
